description: This file defines a React hook 'useUserFeatureOptIn' for managing user feature opt-in settings, including fetching, updating, and warning logic related to feature states and reasons.

methods.name: useMutationCallbacks
methods.description: Creates callback functions for success and error handling during feature state mutations, showing toast notifications.

methods.name: normalizeUserFeatures
methods.description: Transforms raw user feature data into normalized feature objects.

methods.name: createUserBlockedWarningFn
methods.description: Generates a function to produce warning messages for features blocked by certain reasons.

methods.name: isUserBlockedByHigherLevel
methods.description: Checks if a feature is blocked by higher-level reasons such as organization or team disablement.
